adjudication.rationale: The diff shows the client sending `DELETE` to `/admin/groups/:id/members.json` with `data: { user_id: ... }` and the server action `remove_member` doing `params.require(:user_id)`. But nothing in the diff demonstrates that Rails/Rack will fail to parse `user_id` for a DELETE with form-encoded data; Rails commonly parses request parameters for DELETE/PUT/PATCH as well as query params. Also, if `user_id` were missing, `params.require(:user_id)` would raise (likely yielding an error response), not “silently” fail as the finding claims. So the asserted defect isn’t verifiable from this diff.
